title: Exceptions and using — one screen
rememberThis: You throw Exception-derived objects, not arbitrary values. JavaScript can throw anything; C# cannot.
catch only when you can restore a known state. Queue workers log, retry, or dead-letter — they do not empty-catch Exception.
using / await using is try/finally that calls Dispose / DisposeAsync. SkiaSharp surfaces are IDisposable. Finalizers are module 14.
bullets: when filters keep catch blocks from swallowing the wrong HttpRequestException or SqlException.
throw; preserves the stack trace. throw ex; resets it. Wrap with InnerException when you add domain context.
Unobserved Task exceptions are an async story — module 13. Do not invent a finalizer to close a SKSurface.
